description: LightGroup surface hidden (gate-off, honest undrivable case). The resident-card light group is driven by sta_residentCardShow, set to CARD_LIGHTGROUP(2) only when val_residentCard==CARD_LIGHTGROUP. But val_residentCard is hard-coded to 1 (CARD_CURRENTTIME) under the ALWASYS_SHOW_UI else-branch at diAEControl.cpp L122 and never assigned any other value, so sta_residentCardShow can never equal CARD_LIGHTGROUP and the LightGroup Draw/SetData body early-returns without producing a texture. The surface therefore cannot be shown through the can[]/mem[]/someip harness. This case drives the master frame and asserts the negative label, documenting LightGroup as undrivable until the val_residentCard origin is re-based.
